title: Show incremental portfolio analysis progress
description:
As an operator, I want a living optimization Report to show assessment and diagnosis progress while those loops run, so that I can distinguish active work from a stalled process.

Out of scope: per-score workbook revisions, new backend resources, and optimizer mutations.

Feature: Incremental portfolio analysis progress

Scenario: Deterministic assessment is running
Given a living optimization Report has published its ranked portfolio
When ranked scores are assessed over a long-running loop
Then the existing Analysis TaskStage exposes processed and total work
And the Report overview displays the same current progress without a new immutable workbook revision

Scenario: Semantic diagnosis is running
Given deterministic assessment is complete
When selected scores receive semantic diagnosis
Then progress continues from the assessment count through the combined analysis total
And the current activity clearly identifies semantic diagnosis

Scenario: Progress publication fails
Given stakeholder-visible progress cannot be durably updated
When the orchestrator attempts to advance analysis
Then the run fails closed rather than continuing ahead of its visible state

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Observed acceptance gap: a newly opened living report can render before its Task link hydrates. If the linking Report update is missed, the current refresh hook does not subscribe or poll because taskId is absent; ProcedureTask and cover metrics then appear only after navigation or reload. Add a scenario requiring selected reports to reconcile while Task authority is still hydrating.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Acceptance evidence: with a newly created selected Report left mounted, the dashboard updated without navigation or reload from revision 1 with 0 inspected / 0 in scope / 0 portfolio scores to revision 2 with 56 scorecards inspected / 1 in scope / 30 portfolio scores and 10 of 30 assessments. The Report card subtitle also hydrated live. Focused hook tests and dashboard frontend/backend typechecks pass.
